beat: Wednesday Chotu silence, wardrobe choice, online physics session

lines.original: Wednesday, while coming back from college, she looked for Chotu in the store.... he has been keeping his distance from her... she thought perhaps he felt embarrassed cumming in her hands..... He just smiled and waved at her but didn't talk anything.... Wanting to not disturb him, she took waved and left him quietly...
lines.local: Wednesday college se lautte hue Dhika ne store par Chotu ko dhoondha. Woh usse doori banaaye hue tha. Dhika ko laga shayad apne ejaculation aur uske haathon wali ghatna se embarrassed hai. Chotu ne bas smile karke wave kiya, baat nahi ki. Use disturb na karne ke liye Dhika bhi wave karke chupchaap chali gayi.

lines.original: She came back to her house and refreshed and was getting her dressed changed into something comfortable.... lately with wearing short and T shirt and a few times not even T shirt, she started liking the freeness..... not that she hated wearing full dress outside... but now a days, the taste of comfortable feeling is making her to rip off the saree as soon as she reaches home...
lines.local: Ghar aakar Dhika fresh hui aur comfortable kapde badalne lagi. Aajkal shorts aur T-shirt, kabhi T-shirt ke bina, ghar mein aazaadi use acchi lagne lagi thi. Bahar full dress se nafrat nahi thi, par ghar aate hi saree utaarne ka mann karta tha.

lines.original: So, just as said... she removed her saree and was going through her wardrobe in just panty and a full bra... she decided to wear another half hand T shirt and an extra short skirt.... Anyways since no one is coming... she thought she would wear this new extra short skirt which she has never worn before.... all together it covered only 6 inches of her thighs.... she wanted to surprise John today....
lines.local: Saree utaarkar woh panty aur full bra mein wardrobe dekh rahi thi. Half-sleeve T-shirt aur nayi extra-short skirt choose ki; kyunki ghar par koi nahi aane wala tha. Skirt uski thighs ko total sirf chhe inches cover karti thi; pehle kabhi nahi pehni thi. Aaj John ko surprise dene ka iraada tha.

lines.original: While she was getting dressed, she looked at the boxes of lace bras in the wardrobe.... normally she wouldn't mind them just like a lot of other dresses John has brought for her.... hoping she would wear them one day... but today those bra boxes caught her eyes....
lines.local: Kapde chunte hue uski nazar wardrobe mein lace-bra boxes par gayi. John kai dresses ki tarah yeh bhi laaya tha aur ummeed karta tha woh kabhi pehnegi; pehle boxes par dhyan nahi jaata tha, aaj alag baat thi.

lines.original: She remembered what Bantu told her couple of days ago.... taking one box...she opened it and examined the material... it was nice but not as soft as she expected it too be... also she noticed the top part of the bra was little see through....
lines.local: Use kuch din pehle Bantu ki baat yaad aayi. Ek box kholkar lace material check kiya—expected se kam soft laga; upper part thoda see-through bhi tha.

lines.original: Dhika: is this why that fellow asked me to wear it... hehe... dirty fellow... but he has even seen that portion without see through material...she giggled...
lines.local: Dhika: Kya isi liye us dirty fellow ne pehenne ko kaha tha? Hehe… waise woh toh bina see-through material ke bhi woh hissa dekh chuka hai. Woh giggle ki.

lines.original: Anyway, she is alone at home and so decided to wear one and see how it feels.... she just finished up dressing... while she heard her laptop's skype call....
lines.local: Ghar mein akeli thi, isliye ek lace bra pehenkar feel check karne ka decide kiya. Dressing complete hi hui thi ki laptop par Skype call baj uthi.

lines.original: Dhika: Hello dears.... enjoying home town....
lines.local: Dhika: Hello dears! Hometown enjoy kar rahe ho?

lines.original: Bantu: no miss.... its very boring...
lines.local: Bantu: Nahi miss, bahut boring hai.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe.. come back then.....
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, phir wapas aa jao.

lines.original: Bobby: Hi miss....
lines.local: Bobby: Hi miss!

lines.original: She asked them the details of this Swiss program and the competition and Bobby explained it to her... The competition will be held on national level by the Theoretical Physicist association and they are trying to motivate brilliant minded kids to persure their field... About 20 pairs of filtered and preselected students will be participating and the winners (  a pair of students) will be granted full expense to visit Swiss to see the Large Hadron Collider along with one mentor, who is to be their personal companion.... It will be 5 days trip...
lines.local: Dhika ne Swiss programme aur competition ki details poochhi. Bobby ne bataya ki national-level Theoretical Physicist association competition brilliant students ko field mein motivate karne ke liye hai; kareeb 20 preselected student pairs compete karenge. Winning pair aur ek mentor ko sab expenses ke saath Switzerland jaakar Large Hadron Collider dekhne ka paanch din ka trip milega.

lines.original: Bobby explained excitedly..... They talked about few more aspects in detail....
lines.local: Bobby ne excited hokar programme bataya; phir teeno ne uske aur aspects detail mein discuss kiye.

lines.original: Dhika and the twins started going through today's topics.... all went fine for another 30 minutes.....but Bantu got impatient...
lines.local: Dhika aur twins aaj ke topics padhne lage. Lagbhag 30 minutes sab theek raha, phir Bantu impatient ho gaya.

lines.original: Bantu: miss..... are you wearing the chain we gifted...
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, humne jo chain gift ki thi, pehni hai?

lines.original: Dhika: smiling a little... yesss... whyyyyy?
lines.local: Dhika halka muskuraakar: Haan… kyun?

lines.original: Bantu: oh nothing miss.... just that Bobby was saying he wanted to see it....
lines.local: Bantu: Koi baat nahi miss, bas Bobby keh raha tha use dekhna hai.

lines.original: Dhika: oh I see.... okay then you go out.... I will show it to Bobby and then we can resume the session..... she teased him.....
lines.local: Dhika: Achha? Toh tum bahar jao; main Bobby ko dikha deti hoon, phir session resume karenge! Woh Bantu ko tease kar rahi thi.

lines.original: Bantu: what?? why..... I won't go anywhere..... he fought back like a child....
lines.local: Bantu bacchon ki tarah virodh karke: Kya? Kyun? Main kahin nahi jaaunga!

lines.original: Dhika: hehe.... so Bobby dear... you really wanted to see or Bantu is making you too...
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe… Bobby dear, sach mein tum dekhna chahte the ya Bantu tumhe beech mein laa raha hai?
